name: Hwan Kim
bio: Hwan Kim is an Assistant professor in the [Department of Service and Design Engineering](https://www.sungshin.ac.kr/serdesign/) at [Sungshin Women's University](https://www.sungshin.ac.kr/). He is a Human–Computer Interaction (HCI) researcher. He designs interactive technologies that support human cognition and everyday activities. His research spans wearable devices, VR/AR interfaces, digital accessibilities, and haptic technologies. His research combines emerging computing technologies with design to create interactive devices and products that enable new experiences and improve people's everyday lives.
